title: Quentin Lake apologized to Justin Herbert for "deli meat" and "seeing ghosts" comments

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Quentin Lake apologized to Justin Herbert for "deli meat" and "seeing ghosts" comments
sources.description: Rams safety Quentin Lake got plenty of attention for comments he made about intercepting a pass thrown by Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, but on reflection, Lake didn't like the attention he generated.
